problem: Production pricing had the i18n stylesheet/script already present before final shell projection, causing apply-i18n.mjs to return early and skip injecting the mobile language control into the final mobile navigation.
root_cause: Asset presence and mobile-control presence were incorrectly coupled in one early-return condition. Asset idempotence suppressed a separate structural injection responsibility.
prevention: Treat asset injection and mobile language-control injection as independent idempotent responsibilities.
If i18n assets already exist, skip only the asset write; always evaluate injectMobileLanguage on the final built HTML.
Keep Playwright NL→EN→NL proof on /, /prijzen and /systemen-koppelen at mobile viewport as the production gate.
Do not report LIVE until Netlify commit_ref equals main and the visible mobile language selector is proven on production.

evidence.failure: visible mobile language select is missing after opening mobile navigation
